messages:
Maria (PM): Heads-up — ACME pilot just confirmed they need private deploy with HSM-backed keys and a 99.9% latency SLA for inference p95. They want staging by the end of next quarter.
Ajay (Runtime Eng): That SLA + HSM in a private stack is a pretty tight ask. Do we have capacity for dedicated GPUs in their region?
Kevin (Infra): Not without shifting a slot from the current Dedicated pool. We have two available prewarm slots, but they’re promised to Beacon pilot unless we reschedule.
Maria (PM): If we can do staggered onramp (staging limited to a small tenant set, then expand), ACME will take that as a compromise. Staging by EoQ, full by +6 weeks.
Elaine (Security): HSM/KMS integration will require our standard attestation + a short pen test. Also need the key policy doc signed before prod. Timeline: attestation + config ~10 business days, pen test ~5 days.
Ajay (Runtime Eng): From runtime side: work items — (1) build config for private control plane with HSM plug-in, (2) validate model quantization profile to hit p95, (3) add fallback to hosted-compatible variant for degraded nodes. I can scope (1)+(3) as 2 sprints if we get an infra slot.
Kevin (Infra): If we reassign one prewarm slot, we can provision infra in ~7 days (networking, VPC peering, NATs). But that means Beacon must accept a 2-week delay or get burst buffer instead.
Maria (PM): I’ll loop in Beacon PM to negotiate. For ACME, can we propose a canary staging: 10% traffic for 48h, then 50% for 72h, then full? That buys time for sec checks.
Ajay (Runtime Eng): Canary plan sounds fine. For observability we need tracing + token-level cost telemetry enabled for the canary. Also want a prompt set for quality checks.
Elaine (Security): Approved in principle. Add the following gating: (a) HSM attestation complete, (b) pen test no critical issues, (c) canary metrics (error rate <0.5%, latency p95 within SLA) for 48h.
Maria (PM): Great — I'll draft launch criteria and the customer contract amendment. Who can own the rollout playbook?
Ajay (Runtime Eng): I can draft the rollout playbook (scripts + runbook) and include the fallback policy. Will attach a config snippet for canary routing:```yaml
canary:
  percent: 10
  duration: 48h
  rollback_on:
    - error_rate: 0.5
    - p95_latency_increase: 15%
```
Kevin (Infra): I’ll own infra provisioning and VPC peering. Need Maria to confirm region and the final slot transfer decision.
Elaine (Security): I’ll schedule the attestation and pen test with the security team. Please ping me when the infra is live so we can run the checks.
Maria (PM): Action items: (1) Maria: negotiate Beacon slot or confirm transfer by EOD Tue; (2) Kevin: prep infra template asap once slot confirmed; (3) Ajay: draft rollout playbook and telemetry hooks by next Wed; (4) Elaine: book attestation/pen test block. If everyone agrees, I’ll put this into the initiative board and flag as "customer-driven high priority".
Ajay (Runtime Eng): Agree. One ask — if we need to hit p95, we should enable KV prefix caching early; will add to playbook.
Kevin (Infra): Noted. Network/security checklist will include KMS endpoints and NAT sizing.
ops-bot: Reminder: please add the "ACME private pilot" ticket to the launch-lane board — template created at /boards/launch-lane/ACME-private-pilot.
Maria (PM): Thanks all — I'll update the board and send a follow-up with the Beacon PM thread link. :thumbsup:
